House rules

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The same short list applies to every trip, from a six a.m. airport run to a midnight charter: what is welcome on board, what is not, and the fees attached to the rules that cost us a vehicle.

Please do

Dance, if the vehicle you booked has a floor for it. Play your music as loud as you like. Just not "the neighbors call the cops" loud. Passengers 21 and over bring their own alcohol, and we do not sell it. Arizona vehicle-for-hire open-container policy, A.R.S. § 4-251, allows it, and if anyone under 21 rides, no alcohol comes on that trip. Bring your playlist and your people. Ask your chauffeur for anything. Stops, temperature, volume, a photo. Really. Settle in and enjoy the ride. That is the whole point.

Please do not

No eating or food inside the vehicle. Drinks are fine; snacks wait for the next stop. No underage drinking. Anyone under 21 stays on soft drinks. No standing on the seats or sitting on the seat backs. No heels or shoes on the seats. They are leather and they remember. Take your trash with you at the end. Cans, cups, confetti, all of it. Be kind to your chauffeur. They are the reason everyone gets home. No smoking or vaping of any kind. The smell does not leave, so this one carries a fee. Keep the drinks in the cups. Minor spills are fine; a can or two on the floor counts as excessive and carries a cleaning fee. If someone gets sick in the vehicle, we have to deep clean it, and that carries a cleaning fee. Pace yourselves.

The 3 fees

No smoking or vaping of any kind. The smell does not leave, so this one carries a fee. ($1,500) Keep the drinks in the cups. Minor spills are fine; a can or two on the floor counts as excessive and carries a cleaning fee. ($450) If someone gets sick in the vehicle, we have to deep clean it, and that carries a cleaning fee. Pace yourselves. ($450)
